PIXELLAB BROKE CHARACTER ANIMATION CREATION TODAY — your animate call is dead too. POST /v2/characters/animations with the animation in the JSON body now 422s: the path was REUSED for a different operation, 'Resolve Character Animation Group', which takes character_id + animation_group_id as QUERY params and only re-runs a group that already exists ('unknown animation_group_id for this character' on a fresh uuid, 404). There is no create endpoint left: POST /v2/characters/{id}/animations returns 405 Method Not Allowed, and neither v2 nor v1 publishes another. Objects are UNAFFECTED — POST /v2/objects/{object_id}/animations still takes exactly the body we send (mode, animation_description, directions, frame_count, keep_first_frame, end_frame, animation_group_id, display_name, replace_existing). Last clip that generated here: 2026-09-21T07:50:52Z, so it broke within hours. Every probe above was free (422/404/405 are not billed; my balance is unchanged at 35.98 USD) — confirm before you spend. Each domain keeps its own pixellab_client.py copy, so this needs fixing in each once PixelLab restores or publishes the replacement. HYPOTHESIS, UNTESTED because testing it costs a regeneration: a state that ALREADY has a group may still be re-runnable through the resolve endpoint, so redos might work where new states cannot.
